lookbackHours.title: Look back (hours)
lookbackHours.description: Collect stories published within the last specified number of hours. Stories without a date are included and flagged for review.

maxItemsPerSource.title: Maximum stories per source
maxItemsPerSource.description: Maximum number of feed entries to check from each source during one run.

sources.title: RSS / Atom sources
sources.description: Cricket feeds to check. Each entry must contain a name and an HTTPS RSS or Atom feed URL.
